sloka: महाइन्द्रम् अथ सम्प्राप्य रामो राजीव लोचनः ।अध्यारोहन् महाबाहुः शिखरम् द्रुम भूषितम् ॥६-४-९५॥।।
transliteration: mahāindram atha samprāpya rāmo rājīva locanaḥ ।adhyārohan mahābāhuḥ śikharam druma bhūṣitam ॥6-4-95॥।।

translations.english: At that time Lotuseyed Rama of mighty shoulders climbed up the the top of mountain Mahendra adorned with beautiful trees.
